scope: All five additional profiles from the pinned DiffExp MPL notebook: trailing zero and complex letters at orders50/75, weight20 at order100. Native boundaries use independent exact constants, including generalized Frobenius logarithms for the trailing zero. No original value is used as a native boundary.
precision_policy: Original component Precision and absolute Accuracy are preserved separately. Comparison allowances round recorded absolute accuracy downward; these are source uncertainty estimates, not certified intervals. Finite-accuracy zero is checked only with an absolute error. Native accuracy is validated by independent increased working precision and series order. Mantissa length is not an accuracy claim.
timing_policy: Single pinnedCPU28 runs on a shared host. Original notebook helper includes shuffle/logarithm extraction and public transport; native directly solves one triangular system. Work/precision/contours differ, so no matched-algorithm speedup ratio. Two-second polling rounds up monitor process-wall times and may miss short-run RSS peaks; internal phase clocks are reported separately.
original_reported_error_note: The original pm coefficient is preserved verbatim. Shuffle combinations may give a signed, cancellation-prone estimate; it is not substituted for component Accuracy or treated as a rigorous bound.

provenance.native_library_note: Parent-validated immutable current-cache library snapshot, identified exactly by SHA256; native driver only uses rational ordinary/Frobenius interfaces. Compilation and paired profiles pinnedCPU28 sequentially.
provenance.precision_note: Numbers parsed/extracted at recorded precision. Original central coefficient uses Coefficient[result,pm,0]; substitution pm->0 would mix machine uncertainty zero into arbitrary-precision central value, so two failed decoding attempts are preserved but excluded from successful timings.
provenance.complex_driver_revision: Uses a formal exact imaginary-unit parameter whose value is constructed as MPFR Complex(0,1); immutable ordinary solver rejected literal complex polynomial coefficients. Trailing profile numerical equations are unchanged, their per-run binary/source hashes identify the earlier driver.

initial_driver_provenance.native_library_note: Parent-validated immutable current-cache library snapshot, identified exactly by SHA256; native driver only uses rational ordinary/Frobenius interfaces. Compilation and paired profiles pinnedCPU28 sequentially.

preserved_exploratory_failures: Two original harness-only central-value decodings introduced a machine zero from pm->0; fixed by extracting Coefficient[...,pm,0] without changing the original solver.

Frozen ordinary native solver rejected literal exact complex polynomial coefficients; the accepted driver supplies exact i through the supported symbolic parameter map. No production code was changed.

staged_offline_regression.note: This frozen-library gate uses the supported exact symbolic-i parameter. The integrated production test may separately exercise the later literal-complex fix; original benchmark hashes are unchanged.

durable_oracle_syntax.note: Configurable durable harness validated by Wolfram SyntaxQ; original numerical measurements use the separately hashed initial absolute-path harness.
